# What the template cleanup removes from a copy of portfolio-gallery
# (.github/workflows/template-cleanup.yml; ADR-0015). One path per line,
# a file or a folder, from the repository's root. Everything here serves
# only the project itself; what a copy needs to build, check and publish
# its site stays. Most important first.

# They name the project's owner: reports about a copy would reach him.
CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
.github/CODEOWNERS

# The gallery's showcase: contributors' names, sites and screenshots, the
# owner's among them, which no copy receives (ADR-0016). The cleanup also
# drops "in_use" from every design.json.
showcase

# How the project is run: its records, logs, state and rules.
docs/decisions
docs/deferred
logs
briefs
STATE.md
CAPABILITIES.md
MAP.md
CLAUDE.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
SECURITY.md
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE
.github/pull_request_template.md

# The project's own guides and references.
docs/setup-on-github.md
docs/how-to/add-a-design.md
docs/how-to/add-to-the-showcase.md
docs/reference/commands.md
docs/reference/completed.md
docs/reference/provenance.md
docs/reference/standing-checks.md

# The project's own tools: its local gates, its map, its defeat cases,
# its scope check, its showcase check and the test of this cleanup.
.githooks
tools/gates.py
